item.title: 'Best in world' Price set for Cardiff stadium fight
item.description: Lauren Price is one of the most decorated fighters in British boxing history and is now set to headline a summer stadium show in Cardiff.

item.title: Price beats Kotaskova to become undisputed champion
item.description: Lauren Price dominates Michaela Kotaskova to seal her place in history by becoming undisputed world welterweight champion.

item.description: As Lauren Price bids to become Wales' first undisputed world champion, the former footballer already has her sights set on stadium fights.

item.title: Opetaia out of Wilder fight on Fury-Joshua card
item.description: Australian Jai Opetaia withdraws from his heavyweight fight with Deontay Wilder on the undercard of Tyson Fury's bout with Anthony Joshua in December.

item.description: Lauren Price is eyeing the chance to become Wales' first ever undisputed world boxing champion when she takes on Michaela Kotaskova on Friday, 20 November.

item.title: Fury v Joshua fight to provide 'big boost' to city's economy
item.description: Cardiff is preparing for an influx of fans from across the globe for the 11 December showdown.

item.title: Why Fury was born to fight
item.description: Inspired by his father John and drawn to boxing from a young age, Tyson Fury went on to become heavyweight world champion. BBC Sport takes a look at the defining moments that shaped one of Britain's most extraordinary sporting journeys.

item.title: Irish boxer Reeves dies aged 31 after three months in coma
item.description: Irish boxer Lee Reeves has died aged 31, three months after he suffered serious injuries in a bout in Dublin, his promoter Queensberry has announced.

item.title: Billam-Smith 'devastated' but grateful after loss
item.description: Chris Billam-Smith reflects on his loss to Cheavon Clarke in November and speaks about what will come next for him.

item.title: At 13, I wrote that I'll become WBC champion of the world - Hutchinson
item.description: Before his WBC light-heavyweight title fight on Saturday against Joshua Buatsi, Scottish boxer Willy Hutchinson reveals the ambition he had as a 13-year-old, when he wrote down his goals as a boxer - which included becoming WBC champion of the world.

item.title: From influencers to queens of women's boxing - five years of MVP
